newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins steady in thin trade, no IMF impact.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins steady in thin trade, no IMF impact.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were little changed in quiet Friday trading, with prices edging down on a correction after U.S. Treasuries dipped overnight, dealers said.
Earlier they said the market was unaffected by news Russia expects to receive money from the IMF loan soon after May.

IMF Managing Director Michel Camdessus said on Thursday the IMF board was likely to approve the 1997 part of Russia's three-year programme in May and payments of the loan would resume soon afterwards.
"There is absolutely nothing going on. Prices just eased a little bit in the morning tracking U.S. Treasuries and nothing else," a Sberbank dealer said.
Dealers said market activity was fading ahead of Russia's Mayday and Victory Day holidays on May 1 and 9 and annual interest payments on MinFins due in mid-May.
